retrievalProfile.description: A hazy, low-contrast group portrait featuring a mix of formal and bohemian fashion set against a desaturated architectural backdrop with large-scale geometric typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A horizontal group composition of four individuals walking toward the viewer in a desaturated, hazy outdoor setting. The lighting is bright and diffuse, creating a dreamlike, overexposed quality that softens the background architecture. Large, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif text frames the top and bottom of the image, utilizing gradients and transparency to blend with the scene.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between the two male figures on the flanks and two female figures in the center
Contrast between the dark formal attire and the warm ochre/gold central dress
Interaction between the large-scale typography and the atmospheric haze
Linear perspective of the motel balcony echoing the horizontal text placement
coreInvariants: Diffuse, high-key lighting with minimal hard shadows
Atmospheric haze or light fog effect

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four full-length figures arranged horizontally across the mid-ground, occupying the central 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the ochre dress acts as the primary color anchor against the otherwise desaturated scene.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the top-aligned text, down through the central figures, to the bottom-aligned text, following the vertical lines of the palm tree and figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper sky area and lower foreground pavement to accommodate large-scale text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated beige and grey (background and atmosphere)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (outer figures' clothing)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Ochre and gold (central dress and top text gradient)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation across the board with high value (brightness), creating a 'washed out' look.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Extreme letter spacing (tracking) to span the full width of the frame

treatment.fill: linear gradient (gold to transparent or white)

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in two different weights or treatments for top and bottom text.
graphicDevices: Atmospheric depth (text appears partially behind haze)

candidateDirections.reason: Clean geometric structure and modern authority
Classic geometric proportions with circular O
Modern geometric sans with wide availability

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a wide-angle shot of four people (two men in suits, two women in dresses) walking toward the camera at a desaturated 1960s motel. Apply a heavy atmospheric haze and overexpose the sky to a bright off-white. Ensure the central woman wears a flowing ochre-colored dress.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, uppercase geometric sans-serif text at the very top and bottom. The top text should have a subtle gold-to-transparent gradient. The bottom text should be white with high transparency, allowing the pavement texture to show through.

verificationChecks: Is the tracking wide enough to span the image width?
Is the overall image contrast low and hazy?
Are the subjects framed by the text rather than obscured by it?

adjustableVariables: Gradient color of the top text
Specific architectural style of the background
mustRedesign: Do not use the exact wording from the original image
Ensure the faces are generic and not likenesses of specific celebrities
postGenerationChecks: Check for 4 distinct figures with consistent lighting
Verify text is perfectly horizontal and centered
Ensure the ochre dress is the primary color pop
Confirm the 'washed out' high-key aesthetic is maintained
recipe.reuseFormula: Geometric Sans Typography + Hazy Motel Backdrop + Desaturated Group Portrait = Modern Country Aesthetic
